domain: unordered distinct pairs of the 1684 observed source street segments
failure_policy: union of dependent consecutive-stop bus connection IDs; walking and metro fixed
parameter_grid: all W and K from baseline.json, both bus and bus_metro
grouping: exact failed-connection union; retain single-signature pair identities and street multiplicities
selection_rule: exhaustive if benchmark projects at most 900 seconds; otherwise simple random sample without replacement of street-pair ranks
interaction: C_count = joint_loss - first_single_loss - second_single_loss; C_share = C_count / 65677
interpretation: deterministic interaction in the screened static model; no claim of independent failure probability or dynamic cascade
